name: berean
description: A Darby Bible reader: Rust API + Expo (React Native) client for iOS, Android and web

scripts.data: cd rs && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH BEREAN_PUBLIC=../client/public/bible cargo run --release --bin berean-build-data -- ../data
scripts.dev:api: cd rs && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo run --release --bin berean
scripts.build: node scripts/credits-html.mjs && cd client && npx expo export --platform web --clear && node scripts/make-sw.mjs dist && cd .. && node scripts/precompress.mjs client/dist
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run build:server
